summary: GasLog Partners LP filed a Form 6-K reporting an agreement to sell the Methane Rita Andrea, a 145,000 cbm steam turbine LNG carrier built in 2006, to an unrelated third party. The transaction is expected to close in Q2 2026 upon completion of dry-docking. The vessel was reclassified as held for sale, with a $7.7 million impairment recognized. No purchase price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The sale is part of ongoing fleet reduction following prior vessel sales and redeliveries. Watch for completion timing and potential further divestitures.
